explanation: I found no matching Mathlib declaration. The theorem reduces the library's Deligne theorem statement to small categories by passing to the library's own small model `SmallDeligne`. All of its content is built from the library's own definitions: `DeligneTheoremStatement`, `DeligneFibreFunctor`, `HasScalarUnit`, `TensorGeneratedBy`, `ModerateLengthGrowth` and `smallDeligneEquiv`. Mathlib has no formalisation of Deligne's theorem on tensor categories, no fibre functors of this kind, and no such reduction to small categories. The proof uses only the library's own transfer lemmas along an equivalence, so there is nothing in Mathlib it could duplicate. I did not run a search because these concepts are not in Mathlib at all.
